The best of both worlds – fuzz and overdrive – in a single pedal! Freud provides the perfect cure for fuzz sounding thin and stark by adding a built-in overdrive at the end of a classic FF fuzz circuit. A versatile pedal, Pink Freud goes from screaming fuzz to shimmering clean, all with a simple roll-off of your guitar’s volume knob. Pink Freud features: Unique hybrid design of classic germanium FF fuzz plus overdrive Two matched NOS Russian military germanium transistors Controls for Level, Tone and Attack Fully hand-wired analog circuitry Compact MXR-sized enclosure True bypass 3PDT switching Bright indicator LED Accepts standard 9V pedal adaptor 9V DC battery clip included NOW SHIPPING Worldwide Delivery Available! *All product names used in this webpage are trademarks of their respective owners, which are in no way associated or affiliated with Big Knob Pedals. While we appreciate our good friend Gearmanndude showcasing the Freud, setting his DrZ to a slight crunch – while the proper setting for a conventional fuzz pedal – didn’t really do it justice here. By effectively having now two crunch ODs in series, this particular demo sounded a tad over-the-top IOHO. At the 5:37 mark you hear perhaps a closer taste of its intended tone when GMD briefly backs off his guitar volume. Freud’s strength comes from sounding like a premium OD (based on a Kalamazoo/Klon type OD sound) when your guitar’s volume is turned down to around 6-8 but then like a classic full-sounding FF fuzz with the guitar at 10. This is not your typical fuzz, but a unique hybrid expressly designed to sound good straight out of the pedal with no additional amp “doctoring” needed – pardon the pun.
